initialExam.title: ICAR NET 2026
initialExam.description: ICAR National Eligibility Test for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and eligibility for Assistant Professor in agricultural universities and ICAR institutes. Conducted for over 60 agriculture and allied science disciplines.
initialExam.eligibility: Master's in Agriculture/allied sciences with 55%+ (50% SC/ST)
initialExam.qualifications: Master's in Agriculture/Allied Sciences with 55% marks
initialExam.ageLimit: No age limit for JRF (28 years for Lecturership)
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I (General): Agriculture & General Knowledge - Agronomy, Soil Science, Entomology, Plant Pathology, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Agricultural Extension, Agricultural Economics. Paper II (Subject-specific): Chosen discipline - Horticulture, Animal Sciences, Fisheries, Forestry, Home Science, Food Technology, Veterinary Sciences, and 60+ other subjects.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I (General): Agriculture & General Knowledge - 100 marks, 90 minutes. Paper II (Subject): Discipline-specific paper - 200 marks, 150 minutes. Total: 300 marks. Objective type MCQs.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Examination (Paper I + Paper II) → Merit-based qualification for JRF/Lectureship

salaryRange.description: JRF: ₹31,000 + HRA; Asst. Professor: Pay Level 10 (7th CPC)

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: JRF: OBC +3, SC/ST +5, PwD +10 years. No age limit for Lectureship eligibility.

initialExam.perks: JRF: Fellowship + Contingency Grant + HRA. Asst. Professor: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Pension, Academic allowance
initialExam.careerGrowth: JRF → SRF → Scientist/Asst. Professor → Associate Professor → Professor → Director/VC.
initialExam.jobRole: JRF: Research in agriculture sciences at ICAR/SAU labs. Asst. Professor: Teaching, research, and extension in agricultural universities.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit asrb.org.in 2. Register 3. Choose subject discipline 4. Fill form 5. Upload documents 6. Pay fee 7. Submit
